title: ¿Qué tal el fin de semana?
setting: Emma te escribe por WhatsApp un lunes por la mañana.

says.t: Morning, Yolanda! How was your weekend?
says.es: ¡Buenos días, Yolanda! ¿Qué tal el fin de semana?

options.feedback: El fin de semana ya pasó: It was lovely.
Con it el pasado de be es was: It was lovely.

options.t: I went to the market with a friend.
options.es: Fui al mercado con una amiga.

options.t: I goed to the market with a friend.
options.es: Fui al mercado con una amiga.

options.t: I go to the market with a friend.
options.es: Fui al mercado con una amiga.
options.feedback: Hablas del sábado, que ya pasó: I went.
Bought ya es pasado: no le añadas -ed.

options.t: My son came for lunch. I made paella.
options.es: Mi hijo vino a comer. Hice paella.

options.t: My son comed for lunch. I maked paella.
options.es: Mi hijo vino a comer. Hice paella.
options.feedback: Dos irregulares: come → came y make → made.

says.t: Lucky him! Did he like it?

options.t: Yes, he did! He ate two plates.
Yes, he liked! He ate two plates.
options.feedback: La respuesta corta repite el ayudante: Yes, he did.

options.t: Yes, he did! He eated two plates.

says.t: Ha ha! That sounds like a perfect weekend.
says.es: ¡Ja, ja! Suena a fin de semana perfecto.

options.t: It was! And you? What did you do?
It was! And you? What you did?
options.feedback: En la pregunta hace falta did delante: What did you do?
